newsitem.title: ITALY: NORDIC SKIING-FAUNER'S FALL HANDS VICTORY TO NORWAY.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-FAUNER'S FALL HANDS VICTORY TO NORWAY.

text.p: Italy's Silvio Fauner fell during the final leg of a World Cup Nordic 4x10 km relay race on Sunday, allowing Norway to snatch first place.
Italy were just ahead when Fauner fell 600 metres from the finish line. Bjorn Daehlie, skiing Norway's final leg, took full advantage to pull away for a comfortable win.
He and his team mates Egil Kristiansen, Anders Eide and Kristen Skjeldal clocked one hour 34 minutes 50.3 seconds, 12 seconds clear of the hapless Fauner.
Russia dominated the women's 4x5 km race, their teams taking first and second places.
Elena Vaelba anchored the winning team, including Nina Gavriliuk, Olga Danilova and Liubov Egorova, to victory in 51 minutes 42.9 seconds.
